Supreme People's Court  China Securities Regulatory Commission

Notice on Issuing the Opinions on Comprehensively Promoting the Construction of a Diversified Dispute Resolution Mechanism for Securities and Futures Disputes

Fa [2018] No. 305

To: the High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region; all local offices, exchanges, subordinate units, and associations of the China Securities Regulatory Commission:

The Opinions of the Supreme People's Court and the China Securities Regulatory Commission on Comprehensively Promoting the Construction of a Diversified Dispute Resolution Mechanism for Securities and Futures Disputes are hereby issued for your earnest implementation.

November 13, 2018

Opinions on Comprehensively Promoting the Construction of a Diversified Dispute Resolution Mechanism for Securities and Futures Disputes

Building a diversified dispute resolution mechanism for securities and futures disputes is an important measure to unblock channels for investors to express their demands and seek rights remedies, to consolidate the basic system of the capital market, and to protect the legitimate rights and interests of investors. Since the Supreme People's Court and the China Securities Regulatory Commission jointly issued the Notice on Carrying Out Pilot Work on a Diversified Dispute Resolution Mechanism for Securities and Futures Disputes in Some Regions of the Country (Fa [2016] No. 149) in 2016, the people's courts in the pilot regions, securities and futures regulatory authorities, and pilot mediation organizations have strengthened coordination and linkage, fully leveraged the role of the diversified dispute resolution mechanism, resolved securities and futures disputes in a lawful, fair, and efficient manner, and effectively protected the legitimate rights and interests of investors. The pilot work has achieved positive results. In order to implement the Opinions of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council on Improving the Diversified Dispute Resolution Mechanism for Conflicts and Disputes, the Opinions of the General Office of the State Council on Further Strengthening the Protection of the Legitimate Rights and Interests of Small and Medium-Sized Investors in the Capital Market, and the Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Further Deepening the Reform of the Diversified Dispute Resolution Mechanism of the People's Courts, the Supreme People's Court and the China Securities Regulatory Commission, on the basis of summarizing the pilot work experience, have decided to jointly carry out the construction of a diversified dispute resolution mechanism for securities and futures disputes nationwide. The following opinions are hereby put forward on relevant matters:

I. Work Objectives

1. To establish and improve a diversified dispute resolution mechanism for securities and futures disputes that is organically connected, coordinated and linked, efficient and convenient for the people, to legally protect the legitimate rights and interests of investors, to maintain an open, fair, and just order in the capital market, and to promote the harmonious and healthy development of the capital market.

II. Work Principles

2. The principle of legality and fairness. Fully respect the investor's right to choose procedures and strictly abide by statutory procedures. The conduct of mediation work shall not violate the basic principles of the law, and shall not harm state interests, social public interests, or the legitimate rights and interests of third parties.

3. The principle of flexibility and convenience. Focus on the actual circumstances of the dispute, flexibly determine the methods, timing, and location for resolving the dispute, facilitate matters for investors as much as possible, and reduce the cost of dispute resolution for the parties. Mediation work shall clarify processing time limits, improve work efficiency, and shall not allow prolonged mediation without resolution.

4. The principle of focusing on prevention. Utilize the function of mediation in preventing conflicts and addressing issues at their source, and promote the dissemination of healthy investment culture, investment concepts, and investment knowledge. People's courts, securities and futures regulatory authorities, and mediation organizations shall strengthen information sharing to prevent the accumulation and escalation of conflicts and disputes.

III. Work Content

(1) Strengthening the Management of Mediation Organizations

5. Strengthen the construction of securities and futures mediation organizations. Securities and futures mediation organizations refer to mediation institutions established or actually managed by securities and futures regulatory authorities, industry organizations, etc. They shall have a standardized organizational form, fixed office premises and mediation venues, professional mediators, and a sound mediation work system. The China Securities Regulatory Commission is responsible for the identification and management of securities and futures mediation organizations and shall publish them periodically after consulting with the Supreme People's Court.

6. Standardize the internal management of mediation organizations. Mediation organizations shall formulate work systems and process management, and establish a scientific assessment and evaluation system and an accountability system.

7. Strengthen the building of the mediator team. Mediation organizations shall strengthen the political and ideological education, professional ethics construction, and professional skills training of mediators, improve the basic requirements for mediators to practice, formulate mediator work guidelines, and establish and improve a full-time or expert mediator system.

8. Mediation organizations shall not charge fees for accepting mediation applications for disputes involving small and medium-sized investors.

9. Establish a system of rosters for specially invited mediation organizations and specially invited mediators for securities and futures disputes. People's courts at all levels shall include mediation organizations and their mediators in the rosters, make dynamic updates and maintenance, and provide complete and accurate information on mediation organizations and mediators to the parties in securities and futures disputes for their voluntary choice.

(2) Improving the Mechanism for Connecting Litigation and Mediation

10. Scope of the diversified dispute resolution mechanism for securities and futures disputes. Disputes over contracts and tort liability arising from securities, futures, funds, and other capital market investment business between natural persons, legal persons, and unincorporated organizations all fall within the scope of mediation. Non-litigation mediation, advance compensation, etc., conducted by securities and futures regulatory authorities and mediation organizations may all be linked with judicial litigation.

11. Judicial confirmation system for mediation agreements. Mediation agreements reached through mediation by a mediation organization have the nature of civil contracts. After being signed and sealed by the mediator and the mediation organization, the parties may apply to the people's court with jurisdiction to confirm their validity. Cases where parties apply for confirmation of mediation agreements shall be handled in accordance with the provisions of Section 6 of Chapter 15 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and relevant judicial interpretations.

If one party refuses to perform a mediation agreement confirmed as effective by the people's court, which has clear subjects and content for performance, the other party may apply to the people's court for compulsory execution.

12. Implement the mechanism for assigning mediation or entrusting mediation. In the process of accepting and hearing securities and futures disputes, the people's court shall fully exercise its power of interpretation in accordance with the law. With the consent of both parties, it shall guide the parties to resolve the dispute through mediation organizations by means such as assigning before case filing, entrusting after case filing, or inviting during litigation.

If a mediation agreement is reached through mediation assigned by the people's court and the parties apply for judicial confirmation, the people's court that assigned the mediation shall accept the case in accordance with the law.

13. Establish a model judgment mechanism. In the process of handling large-scale group disputes, securities and futures regulatory authorities may entrust mediation organizations with centralized mediation of matters related to the protection of investors' rights. For civil compensation group disputes arising from illegal acts such as false statements, insider trading, and market manipulation, where it is necessary for the people's court to declare legal rules and unify the application of law through judicial judgments, the court hearing the case may select several representative cases as model cases in terms of fact-finding and legal application, hear them first and render judgments promptly; through the standards for fact-finding and legal application established by the model judgments, guide other parties to resolve disputes through the diversified dispute resolution mechanism for securities and futures disputes, reduce the cost of rights protection for investors, and improve the efficiency of conflict resolution.

14. Establish a mechanism for expedited mediation of small claims. To better resolve capital market disputes, securities and futures market operators are encouraged to sign agreements with mediation organizations in advance on a voluntary basis, committing to unconditionally accept the mediation proposal put forward by the mediation organization within a certain amount. After a dispute arises, upon application by the investor, if the mediation proposal put forward by the mediation organization falls within that amount and the investor agrees, it shall be deemed that both parties have voluntarily reached a mediation agreement, and the securities and futures market operator shall accept it. If a party applies for judicial confirmation of that mediation agreement, the people's court shall handle it in accordance with the law.

15. Explore the establishment of a mechanism for recording undisputed facts. When the mediation process ends and the parties have not reached a mediation agreement, the mediator, after obtaining the consent of all parties, may record in writing the facts on which both parties had no dispute during the mediation process, and the parties shall sign to confirm. In the course of litigation proceedings, except where state interests, social public interests, or the legitimate rights and interests of others are involved, the parties need not provide evidence for the undisputed facts confirmed during the mediation process.

16. Explore the establishment of a pre-mediation procedure. For securities, futures, fund, and other disputes suitable for mediation, people's courts with the appropriate conditions, on the basis of soliciting the willingness of the parties, may guide the parties to submit to pre-mediation by a specially invited mediation organization or a specially invited mediator before registration and filing of the lawsuit.

17. Fully utilize online dispute resolution methods to carry out work. Build an online platform for resolving securities and futures disputes based on the "China Investor Website" (www.investor.gov.cn), and connect it with the case handling information platform of the people's courts to facilitate the online connection between litigation and mediation. Mediation organizations shall fully utilize modern media tools such as the "China Investor Website", organically combine "face-to-face" communication with online dialogue, real-time dispute resolution, etc., study and formulate rules for online dispute resolution, and summarize and promote practices such as remote mediation. People's courts at all levels shall, with the aid of modern technological means such as the Internet, explore the conduct of online entrustment or assignment of mediation, online judicial confirmation of mediation agreements, and facilitate the participation of parties in diversified dispute resolution through accepting relevant applications, remote review and confirmation, fast and professional service channels, electronic supervision, electronic service, etc., thereby improving work quality and efficiency.

(3) Strengthening the Guarantee and Implementation of the Diversified Dispute Resolution Mechanism

18. Give full play to the function of the supervision procedure. Mediation agreements that meet the statutory conditions may serve as the basis for a party to apply to the basic people's court with jurisdiction for an order to pay.

19. Scope of judicial adjudication of disputes concerning mediation agreements. If a dispute arises over the performance or content of a mediation agreement, the parties may file a lawsuit with the people's court regarding the mediation agreement, and the people's court shall hear the case as a contract dispute. If one party files a lawsuit with the people's court based on the original dispute, and the other party raises a defense based on the mediation agreement and provides the mediation agreement, the people's court shall adjudicate on the content of the mediation agreement.

20. Strengthen regulatory support for the diversified dispute resolution mechanism. If an investor applies for mediation to resolve a dispute, the securities and futures market operator shall actively participate in the mediation and cooperate with the people's court and the mediation organization in finding the facts. If a securities and futures market operator refuses to perform a mediation agreement that has been reached without justifiable reasons, the securities and futures regulatory authority shall record such conduct in the securities and futures market credit archive database in accordance with the law.

21. Strengthen coordinated law enforcement and severely crack down on acts that harm the legitimate rights and interests of investors. People's courts and securities and futures regulatory authorities shall give full play to their respective functional advantages, and promptly take preservation measures in accordance with the law against acts that may harm the legitimate rights and interests of investors, such as destroying evidence and transferring property. Illegal or irregular acts discovered in the course of work shall be investigated and dealt with in a timely manner; if suspected of constituting a crime, the case shall be transferred to the relevant judicial authority for handling in accordance with the law.

22. Strengthen financial guarantees and personnel training. Securities and futures regulatory authorities, industry self-regulatory organizations, etc., shall provide the necessary personnel, funds, and material guarantees for establishing and improving the diversified dispute resolution mechanism for securities and futures disputes, and increase training efforts for mediators; people's courts with the appropriate conditions shall provide mediation rooms specifically for handling securities and futures disputes for the work of specially invited mediation organizations and mediators. Establish a multi-level joint training mechanism between people's courts and securities and futures regulatory authorities, and continuously strengthen the breadth and depth of business exchanges.

IV. Work Requirements

23. Establish a coordination mechanism for diversified dispute resolution of securities and futures disputes. Each High People's Court and securities and futures regulatory authority shall designate a liaison department and contact person respectively to strengthen coordination on problems encountered in the work; strengthen communication, contact, and information sharing, and build a comprehensive early warning mechanism for investigating and resolving securities and futures disputes, to prevent the accumulation and escalation of conflicts and disputes.

24. Strengthen publicity and investor education. People's courts, securities and futures regulatory authorities, industry self-regulatory organizations, specialized investor protection institutions, and mediation organizations shall, through various channels, promptly summarize and publicize typical cases, and play a demonstrative and educational role; increase publicity efforts for the diversified dispute resolution mechanism for securities and futures disputes, enhance understanding of the diversified resolution mechanism among all parties, and guide small and medium-sized investors to change their mindset and protect their rights rationally.

25. Strengthen supervision, guidance, coordination, and management. The Second Civil Division of the Supreme People's Court and the Investor Protection Bureau of the China Securities Regulatory Commission shall establish a working group for the diversified dispute resolution mechanism for securities and futures disputes, specifically responsible for guiding and coordinating the construction of the diversified dispute resolution mechanism for securities and futures disputes. Each High People's Court shall guide, supervise, and inspect the implementation of various work requirements for the diversified resolution mechanism for securities and futures disputes by the people's courts within its jurisdiction. The China Securities Regulatory Commission is responsible for supervising and guiding the work of each mediation organization; each local office is responsible for supervising the strengthening of internal management and standardized operation by the relevant mediation organizations within its jurisdiction, and guiding and supporting each mediation organization in carrying out work within its jurisdiction. Local people's courts at all levels and securities and futures regulatory authorities shall promptly report their work situations and problems encountered to the Supreme People's Court and the China Securities Regulatory Commission level by level.
